arguments.subject: Re: [TCK-4827] URGENT — why am I being logged out every time I switch machines??
arguments.body:
Hi Maya,

Thank you for your detailed message and for being a Pro plan member. I'm sorry for the sudden disruption—this is understandably frustrating, and we take your workflow seriously.

Based on our current documentation and policy, Cursor does not have a device or payment-method link that would automatically log you out when switching between machines. Normally, signing in with your Google SSO account across multiple devices should keep your sign-in sessions active on each one independently.

What you’re describing (each new sign-in logging you out everywhere else) is not expected or intended behavior, and it is not related to any billing or device-binding policy. There have not been any recent announced changes to our sign-in/session policies that would explain what you’re seeing.

This could indicate a technical issue—either with session handling on our side or a problem with cookies/local storage. If your browsers are configured to automatically clear cookies or block third-party cookies, this can sometimes cause session interruptions. However, since this started happening suddenly and across different operating systems, it’s likely something that needs closer investigation by our support team.

I recommend:
1. Checking that your browsers on each machine allow cookies for `app.cursor.com`.
2. Not using any browser extensions that might interfere with sign-in cookies.
3. If you recently changed your Google account password or security settings, sign in to https://myaccount.google.com once, then try Cursor again.

However, because this spans multiple devices and began recently, I am escalating your case to our human support team for priority investigation.

We’ll update you as soon as possible with a root cause or next steps.

Thank you for your patience and for flagging this so thoroughly—our team will resolve this urgently.

Best,
Lyra Support Bot
Cursor Customer Support

arguments.subject: Re: [TCK-4815] Invoice PDF won't download
arguments.body:
Hi Daniel,

Thanks for your message. I understand you’re unable to download your March invoice PDF—let’s get this resolved so you can file your expenses on time.

Based on our current support documentation, if you’re seeing the download button spin indefinitely on multiple browsers, it’s most likely an issue on our side, not with your account or billing details. Here are the next steps:

1. Try clearing your browser’s cache or using a private/incognito window to rule out a stale cookie or extension issue.
2. Make sure you don’t have any extensions enabled that could block downloads from billing.cursor.com.

If the issue persists after these steps and you still can’t download your invoice, this may be a temporary backend problem. In that case, please reply to let us know immediately, and we’ll generate and send your invoice manually while our team investigates.

Thank you for your patience!

Best regards,
Lyra Support Bot
Cursor Customer Support
